offensiveAbilities.name: Confusing Display
offensiveAbilities.description:
The augnagar's writhing limbs and flesh seethe and squirm in a disorienting and unsettling manner. Creatures in a 30ft Emanation must attempt a DC 34 Will Saving Throw save, after which they are temporarily immune to further Confusing Displays for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Stupefied 1 for 1 round.

Failure The creature is stupefied 1 and Confused for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature can't attempt a flat check to recover from confusion whenever it takes damage from an attack or spell.

offensiveAbilities.name: Inhale Vitality
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect The augnagar inhales sharply, drawing life force out of creatures in a 50ft Cone. Creatures in the area take 14d6 Void Damage damage with a Basic DC 34 Fortitude Saving Throw save. A creature that fails its save is also Fatigued.

If any creatures take damage from this activity, the augnagar becomes Quickened for 1 round, and it can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Rotting Curse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 32 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 Drained 1 (1 day)

Stage 2 drained 2 and the creature displays hideous, festering wounds exuding a horrific stench. When the victim takes piercing or slashing damage, creatures within 30 feet must succeed at a DC 32 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Sickened 1. The victim automatically fails this save (1 day).

lv5spells.name: Translocate
lv5spells.description:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

lv7spells.name: Truesight (Constant)
lv7spells.description: You see things within 60 feet as they actually are. The GM rolls a secret counteract check against any illusion, morph or polymorph effect in the area, but only for the purpose of determining whether you see through it (for instance, if the check succeeds against a polymorph spell, you can see the creature's true form, but you don't end the polymorph spell).
